<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,maximum-scale=1,user-scalable=no,viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#05050b">
<title>Mehad's Creation</title>
<style>
:root{
  --bg:#05050b;--card:#0d0e17d9;--line:#ffffff16;--text:#fff;--muted:#b7b7c5;
  --accent:#9a63ff;--accent2:#643ee0;--danger:#ff526d;--ok:#54d98b;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
html,body{margin:0;width:100%;height:100%;background:#05050b;color:var(--text);font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif}
body{overflow:hidden}
button,input,textarea,select{font:inherit}
button{border:0;color:#fff;cursor:pointer}
#app{
 position:fixed;inset:0;background:#05050b center/cover no-repeat;
 transition:background-image .25s ease;
}
#shade{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0009 0%,#0004 35%,#000b 100%);pointer-events:none}
#home{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:auto;padding-bottom:100px}
.top{
 position:sticky;top:0;z-index:20;height:82px;padding:10px 14px;
 display:grid;grid-template-columns:58px 1fr 58px;align-items:center;
 background:linear-gradient(#05050be8,#05050b00);backdrop-filter:blur(8px)
}
.profile-btn{
 width:50px;height:50px;border-radius:50%;padding:0;overflow:hidden;
 border:2px solid #ffffff55;background:#111
}
.profile-btn img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.settings-btn{
 width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;background:#ffffff12;border:1px solid #ffffff18;
 font-size:23px
}
.brand{text-align:center;min-width:0}.brand b{display:block;font-size:19px;line-height:23px}.brand small{font-size:14px;color:#d5baff}
.wrap{width:min(820px,100%);margin:auto;padding:12px}
.card{
 background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:22px;padding:16px;
 margin:12px 0;backdrop-filter:blur(12px);box-shadow:0 15px 40px #0006
}
.hero{text-align:center;padding:18px 16px}.hero-icon{font-size:52px}.hero h2{margin:5px 0 7px;font-size:28px}.hero p{margin:0;color:#ddd}
.section-title{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px}
.section-title h3{margin:0;font-size:19px}
.primary{
 width:100%;padding:14px 16px;border-radius:15px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--accent),var(--accent2));
 font-weight:800;box-shadow:0 8px 22px #6e40d544
}
.secondary{padding:11px 14px;border-radius:13px;background:#ffffff12;border:1px solid #ffffff10}
.danger{padding:11px 14px;border-radius:13px;background:#ff526d1b;color:#ff9aaa;border:1px solid #ff526d22}
.success{padding:11px 14px;border-radius:13px;background:#54d98b1b;color:#a9ffd0}
.row{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap}.row>*{flex:1;min-width:120px}
label{display:block;color:#ddd;font-size:13px;margin:13px 0 6px}
input,textarea,select{
 width:100%;padding:12px 13px;border-radius:13px;border:1px solid #ffffff18;
 background:#05060be8;color:#fff;outline:0
}
textarea{min-height:95px;resize:vertical}
input[type=file]{padding:9px}
.small{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}.muted{color:var(--muted)}
.hidden{display:none!important}
.empty{text-align:center;color:#aaa;padding:28px}
.project-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:12px}
.project-card{
 position:relative;min-height:190px;overflow:hidden;padding:0;margin:0;cursor:pointer
}
.project-bg{position:absolute;inset:0;background:center/cover no-repeat;opacity:.48}
.project-overlay{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(transparent 25%,#000e 100%)}
.project-content{position:relative;min-height:190px;padding:14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.project-photo{width:58px;height:58px;border-radius:16px;object-fit:cover;border:1px solid #fff4}
.project-content .bottom{margin-top:auto}.project-name{font-size:18px;font-weight:800;text-shadow:0 2px 8px #000}.project-meta{font-size:11px;color:#ddd;margin-top:5px}
.media-box{
 position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:20px;border:1px solid #ffffff18;
 min-height:230px;background:#030308;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center
}
.media-box img,.media-box video{width:100%;max-height:420px;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.media-empty{text-align:center;padding:45px 20px;color:#aaa}
.media-tools{position:absolute;right:10px;bottom:10px;display:flex;gap:7px}
.media-tools button{background:#000b;border:1px solid #fff3}
.dots{text-align:center;padding-top:8px}.dot{display:inline-block;width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:#777;margin:0 3px}.dot.active{background:#fff}
.goal{
 display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:center;background:#ffffff09;border:1px solid #ffffff0b;
 padding:9px;border-radius:13px;margin:7px 0
}
.goal input[type=checkbox]{width:20px;height:20px;accent-color:#9a63ff}
.goal-text{flex:1}.goal.done .goal-text{text-decoration:line-through;color:#777}
.timer-box{text-align:center;padding:20px;border-radius:20px;background:#0009;border:1px solid #fff1}
.timer-display{font-size:52px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:2px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.progress{height:9px;background:#ffffff13;border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden;margin:14px 0}.progress>i{display:block;height:100%;width:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--accent),#d8bfff);transition:width .25s}
.reminder{
 padding:12px;border-radius:14px;background:#ffffff08;border:1px solid #fff1;margin:8px 0
}
.reminder-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;align-items:center}.reminder-time{font-weight:800}
.workout-plan{
 display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;background:#ffffff09;border:1px solid #fff1;
 padding:10px;border-radius:14px;margin:8px 0
}
.workout-thumb{width:72px;height:54px;border-radius:10px;object-fit:cover;background:#000;flex:none}
.workout-plan .info{flex:1;min-width:0}.workout-plan b{display:block}.workout-plan span{font-size:12px;color:#aaa}
.workout-stage{background:#000b;border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #fff1}
.workout-stage video{width:100%;max-height:52vh;display:block;background:#000}
.workout-count{text-align:center;padding:18px}.workout-count .big{font-size:55px;font-weight:900;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.workout-total{text-align:center;padding:15px}.workout-total strong{font-size:25px}
.modal,.setup{
 position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:100;background:#000d;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center
}
.setup{z-index:200;align-items:center;padding:16px;background:#05050bf5}
.sheet{
 width:100%;max-width:820px;max-height:94vh;overflow:auto;padding:18px;
 background:#10111aeF;border:1px solid #fff2;border-radius:26px 26px 0 0
}
.setupbox{width:100%;max-width:470px;padding:22px;background:#10111af5;border:1px solid #fff2;border-radius:26px}
.head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px}.head h2{margin:0}
.close{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;background:#ffffff12;font-size:22px}
.setup-step{display:none}.setup-step.active{display:block}
.setup-photo{display:block;width:115px;height:115px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;border:3px solid #9a63ff;margin:16px auto}
.preview{width:105px;height:105px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:17px;border:1px solid #fff2;margin-top:8px}
.modal-spacer{height:8px}
.toast{
 position:fixed;z-index:400;left:50%;bottom:85px;transform:translateX(-50%);
 max-width:90%;background:#171824;color:#fff;padding:12px 16px;border-radius:14px;
 box-shadow:0 12px 35px #000a;text-align:center
}
.musicbar{
 position:fixed;z-index:30;left:10px;right:10px;bottom:9px;display:none;
 align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:16px;
 background:#0a0b11ed;border:1px solid #fff2;backdrop-filter:blur(10px)
}
.musicbar.show{display:flex}.musicbar .music-title{flex:1;min-width:0;font-size:12px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.timer-chip{display:inline-block;padding:5px 8px;border-radius:9px;background:#9a63ff22;color:#d9c7ff;font-size:11px}
.notice{
 padding:13px;border-radius:15px;background:#9a63ff13;border:1px solid #9a63ff25;color:#ddd
}
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px}.stat{background:#ffffff09;border-radius:14px;padding:12px;text-align:center}.stat b{display:block;font-size:20px}.stat span{font-size:11px;color:#aaa}
@media(max-width:560px){.project-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.timer-display{font-size:45px}.workout-count .big{font-size:48px}}

/* WORKOUT HISTORY */
.workout-history{margin-top:14px}.wh-plan{background:#0b0c14d9;border:1px solid #ffffff14;border-radius:16px;padding:14px;margin-top:12px}.wh-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}.wh-head .wh-name{flex:1;min-width:0}.wh-score{font-size:20px;font-weight:900}.wh-dates{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(130px,1fr));gap:8px;margin-top:12px}.wh-date{border:1px solid #ffffff12;background:#ffffff07;border-radius:12px;padding:9px;text-align:center}.wh-date b{display:block;font-size:16px}.wh-date small{color:#aaa}.wh-date.done{border-color:#54d98b66}.wh-date.missed{border-color:#ff526d66}.wh-date.pending{border-color:#9a63ff66}.wh-mark{margin-top:10px;width:100%}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="app"><div id="shade"></div></div>

<div id="setup" class="setup hidden">
 <div class="setupbox">
  <div class="setup-step active" data-step="1">
   <h2>Welcome, Lord ✨</h2>
   <p class="muted">Create your profile to enter the app.</p>
   <label>Profile Picture</label>
   <input id="sPhoto" type="file" accept="image/*">
   <img id="sPreview" class="setup-photo hidden">
   <button class="primary" style="margin-top:14px" onclick="setupNext(2)">Next →</button>
  </div>
  <div class="setup-step" data-step="2">
   <button class="secondary" onclick="setupNext(1)">← Back</button>
   <h2>Lord, your name?</h2>
   <input id="sName" maxlength="50" placeholder="Enter your name">
   <button class="primary" style="margin-top:14px" onclick="setupNext(3)">Next →</button>
  </div>
  <div class="setup-step" data-step="3">
   <button class="secondary" onclick="setupNext(2)">← Back</button>
   <h2>Lord, your age?</h2>
   <input id="sAge" type="number" min="1" max="120" placeholder="Enter your age">
   <button class="primary" style="margin-top:14px" onclick="finishSetup()">Create Profile ✓</button>
  </div>
 </div>
</div>

<div id="home" class="hidden">
 <div class="top">
  <button class="profile-btn" onclick="openProfile()"><img id="topPhoto"></button>
  <div class="brand"><b>Mehad's Creation</b><small id="auraName">Aura booster</small></div>
  <button class="settings-btn" onclick="openSettings()">⚙️</button>
 </div>
 <div class="wrap">
  <div class="card hero">
   <div id="auraIcon" class="hero-icon">✨</div>
   <h2>Projects</h2><p>Create projects, goals, timers and reminders.</p>
  </div>

  <div class="card">
   <div class="section-title"><h3>🖼️ Featured Media</h3><button class="secondary" onclick="openMediaManager()">＋ Add</button></div>
   <div id="featuredMedia" style="margin-top:12px"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="card">
   <div class="section-title"><h3>📁 My Projects</h3><button class="secondary" onclick="openProjectEditor()">＋ Create</button></div>
   <div id="projectList" class="project-grid" style="margin-top:12px"></div>
   <button class="primary" style="margin-top:12px" onclick="openProjectEditor()">＋ Create Project</button>
  </div>

  <div class="card">
   <div class="section-title"><h3>🏋️ Work Out</h3><button class="secondary" onclick="openWorkoutManager()">Open</button></div>
   <p class="small">Run your plans one after another with video and countdown.</p>
   <button class="primary" onclick="openWorkoutManager()">Open Work Out</button>
  </div>

  <div class="card workout-history">
   <div class="section-title"><h3>📅 Workout Dates & Score</h3><button class="secondary" onclick="refreshWorkoutHistory()">↻ Refresh</button></div>
   <p class="small">Each workout has its own daily record. Finish a workout to get ✓. A missed previous day becomes ✕ and changes that workout's score by −1.</p>
   <div id="workoutHistoryList"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="card">
   <div class="section-title"><h3>🔔 Notifications</h3></div>
   <p class="small">Allow notifications for timer and reminder alerts.</p>
   <button class="secondary" onclick="allowNotifications()">Allow Notifications</button>
  </div>
 </div>
</div>

<div id="modal" class="modal hidden" onclick="if(event.target===this)closeModal()"><div id="sheet" class="sheet"></div></div>
<div id="toast" class="toast hidden"></div>
<div id="musicBar" class="musicbar">
 <span id="musicTitle" class="music-title">No music</span>
 <button class="secondary" onclick="toggleMusic()">▶ / Ⅱ</button>
 <button class="danger" onclick="stopMusic()">■</button>
</div>
<audio id="audio" loop></audio>

<script>
const DEFAULT_BG="data:image/jpeg;base64,";
const STATE_KEY="MEHAD_CREATION_ALL_IN_ONE_V6";
const DB_NAME="MEHAD_CREATION_MEDIA_V1";
let state=loadState(), setupPhoto=null, activeProject=null, featuredIndex=0;
if(!state.workout)state.workout={plans:[],history:{}};
if(!state.workout.history)state.workout.history={};
let projectTick=null, workout=null, workoutTick=null;

function baseState(){
 return {
  profile:null,bg:DEFAULT_BG,aura:"Aura booster",emoji:"✨",
  projects:[],featured:[],musicKey:null,musicName:"",
  workout:{plans:[],history:{}},lastCheck:Date.now()
 };
}
function loadState(){
 try{return Object.assign(baseState(),JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STATE_KEY)||"null")||{})}
 catch(e){return baseState()}
}
function save(){localStorage.setItem(STATE_KEY,JSON.stringify(state))}
function $(id){return document.getElementById(id)}
function esc(v){return String(v??"").replace(/[&<>"']/g,m=>({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;","'":"&#039;"}[m]))}
function toast(msg){
 $("toast").textContent=msg;$("toast").classList.remove("hidden");
 clearTimeout(window.__toast);window.__toast=setTimeout(()=>$("toast").classList.add("hidden"),2400)
}
function setBG(){$("app").style.backgroundImage='url("'+(state.bg||DEFAULT_BG)+'")'}
function showModal(title,body){
 $("sheet").innerHTML='<div class="head"><h2>'+title+'</h2><button class="close" onclick="closeModal()">×</button></div>'+body;
 $("modal").classList.remove("hidden")
}
function closeModal(){$("modal").classList.add("hidden");$("sheet").innerHTML=""}
function setupNext(n){
 document.querySelectorAll(".setup-step").forEach(x=>x.classList.remove("active"));
 document.querySelector('.setup-step[data-step="'+n+'"]').classList.add("active")
}
function fileData(file,cb){
 if(!file)return cb(null);
 const r=new FileReader();r.onload=()=>cb(r.result);r.readAsDataURL(file)
}
function compressImage(data,max=900,quality=.78){
 return new Promise(resolve=>{
  const img=new Image();img.onload=()=>{
   let w=img.width,h=img.height,scale=Math.min(1,max/Math.max(w,h));w=Math.round(w*scale);h=Math.round(h*scale);
   const c=document.createElement("canvas");c.width=w;c.height=h;c.getContext("2d").drawImage(img,0,0,w,h);
   resolve(c.toDataURL("image/jpeg",quality))
  };img.src=data
 })
}
$("sPhoto").onchange=e=>fileData(e.target.files[0],async src=>{
 if(src){setupPhoto=await compressImage(src,700,.8);$("sPreview").src=setupPhoto;$("sPreview").classList.remove("hidden")}
});
function finishSetup(){
 const n=$("sName").value.trim(),a=$("sAge").value.trim();
 if(!setupPhoto)return toast("Please choose a profile picture.");
 if(!n)return toast("Please enter your name.");
 if(!a)return toast("Please enter your age.");
 state.profile={photo:setupPhoto,name:n,age:a};save();startApp();toast("Profile created successfully.")
}
function startApp(){
 $("setup").classList.add("hidden");$("home").classList.remove("hidden");setBG();header();renderProjects();renderFeatured();loadMusic();processWorkoutDays();refreshWorkoutHistory();showTodayWorkoutPopup();
}
function header(){
 if(!state.profile)return;
 $("topPhoto").src=state.profile.photo;$("auraName").textContent=state.aura||"Aura booster";$("auraIcon").textContent=state.emoji||"✨"
}

function openProfile(){
 const p=state.profile;
 showModal("Your Profile",`
  <div style="text-align:center"><img class="setup-photo" src="${p.photo}"></div>
  <div class="card"><b>Name</b><p>${esc(p.name)}</p><b>Age</b><p>${esc(p.age)}</p></div>
  <button class="primary" onclick="editProfile()">Edit Profile</button>
 `)
}
function editProfile(){
 const p=state.profile;
 showModal("Edit Profile",`
  <label>Profile Picture</label><input id="ePhoto" type="file" accept="image/*">
  <img id="ePrev" class="preview" src="${p.photo}">
  <label>Name</label><input id="eName" maxlength="50" value="${esc(p.name)}">
  <label>Age</label><input id="eAge" type="number" min="1" max="120" value="${esc(p.age)}">
  <p class="small">Only your picture, name and age can be edited here.</p>
  <button class="primary" onclick="saveProfile()">Save Changes</button>
 `);
 $("ePhoto").onchange=e=>fileData(e.target.files[0],async src=>{if(src)$("ePrev").src=await compressImage(src,700,.8)})
}
function saveProfile(){
 const n=$("eName").value.trim(),a=$("eAge").value.trim();
 if(!n||!a)return toast("Please fill in name and age.");
 const f=$("ePhoto").files[0];
 const finish=async src=>{state.profile.name=n;state.profile.age=a;if(src)state.profile.photo=await compressImage(src,700,.8);save();header();closeModal();toast("Profile updated.")};
 if(f)fileData(f,finish);else finish(null)
}

async function openSettings(){
 showModal("Settings",`
  <div class="card">
   <h3>🖼️ App Background</h3><p class="small">Change the app background anytime.</p>
   <input id="bgFile" type="file" accept="image/*">
   <button class="secondary" style="margin-top:8px" onclick="resetBG()">Use Default Background</button>
  </div>
  <div class="card">
   <h3>🎵 Background Music</h3>
   <input id="musicFile" type="file" accept="audio/*">
   <div class="row" style="margin-top:8px">
    <button class="secondary" onclick="playSelectedMusic()">▶ Play Music</button>
    <button class="danger" onclick="removeMusic()">Remove Music</button>
   </div>
   <p class="small" id="musicStatus">${state.musicName?esc(state.musicName):"No music selected."}</p>
  </div>
  <div class="card">
   <h3>🤖 Aura Character</h3>
   <label>Aura Name</label><input id="auraInput" value="${esc(state.aura)}">
   <label>Character</label><select id="emoji">
    <option>✨</option><option>🌙</option><option>🖤</option><option>⚡</option><option>🔥</option><option>👑</option><option>🤖</option><option>🌌</option>
   </select>
   <button class="primary" style="margin-top:12px" onclick="saveAura()">Save Character</button>
  </div>
  <div class="card"><h3>🔔 Notifications</h3><button class="secondary" onclick="allowNotifications()">Allow Notifications</button></div>
 `);
 $("emoji").value=state.emoji||"✨";
 $("bgFile").onchange=e=>fileData(e.target.files[0],async src=>{
  if(src){state.bg=await compressImage(src,1200,.78);save();setBG();toast("Background changed.");}
 });
 $("musicFile").onchange=async e=>{
  const f=e.target.files[0];if(!f)return;
  try{state.musicKey="music";await idbPut("music",f);state.musicName=f.name;save();loadMusic();$("musicStatus").textContent=f.name;toast("Music selected. Tap Play Music.");}
  catch(err){toast("Could not save this music file.")}
 }
}
function resetBG(){state.bg=DEFAULT_BG;save();setBG();toast("Default background restored.")}
function saveAura(){state.aura=$("auraInput").value.trim()||"Aura booster";state.emoji=$("emoji").value;save();header();closeModal();toast("Character settings saved.")}
function idbOpen(){
 return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{
  const r=indexedDB.open(DB_NAME,1);
  r.onupgradeneeded=()=>r.result.createObjectStore("files");
  r.onsuccess=()=>resolve(r.result);r.onerror=()=>reject(r.error)
 })
}
async function idbPut(key,val){
 const db=await idbOpen();return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{
  const tx=db.transaction("files","readwrite");tx.objectStore("files").put(val,key);tx.oncomplete=resolve;tx.onerror=()=>reject(tx.error)
 })
}
async function idbGet(key){
 const db=await idbOpen();return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{
  const tx=db.transaction("files","readonly"),r=tx.objectStore("files").get(key);
  r.onsuccess=()=>resolve(r.result);r.onerror=()=>reject(r.error)
 })
}
async function idbDelete(key){
 const db=await idbOpen();return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{
  const tx=db.transaction("files","readwrite");tx.objectStore("files").delete(key);tx.oncomplete=resolve;tx.onerror=()=>reject(tx.error)
 })
}
async function playSelectedMusic(){
 if(!state.musicKey)return toast("Select a music file first.");
 await loadMusic();
 const a=$("audio");a.play().then(()=>toast("Music is playing.")).catch(()=>toast("Tap Play Music again to start playback."))
}
async function loadMusic(){
 if(!state.musicKey){$("musicBar").classList.remove("show");return}
 try{
  const f=await idbGet("music");if(!f)return;
  const url=URL.createObjectURL(f);$("audio").src=url;$("musicTitle").textContent=state.musicName||f.name||"Music";$("musicBar").classList.add("show")
 }catch(e){toast("Music could not be loaded.")}
}
function toggleMusic(){
 const a=$("audio");if(!a.src)return toast("Select music from Settings first.");
 if(a.paused)a.play().catch(()=>toast("Tap Play again."));else a.pause()
}
function stopMusic(){$("audio").pause();$("audio").currentTime=0}
async function removeMusic(){state.musicKey=null;state.musicName="";save();try{await idbDelete("music")}catch(e){}loadMusic();closeModal();toast("Music removed.")}

async function allowNotifications(){
 if(!("Notification"in window))return toast("Notifications are not supported in this browser.");
 const p=await Notification.requestPermission();
 toast(p==="granted"?"Notifications allowed.":"Notification permission was not granted.")
}
function sendNotice(title,body){
 if("Notification"in window&&Notification.permission==="granted"){try{new Notification(title,{body})}catch(e){}}
 toast("🔔 "+title+" — "+body)
}

/* FEATURED MEDIA */
async function openMediaManager(){
 showModal("Featured Media",`
  <div class="notice">Add your own photos or videos. They appear in the media area on the Home screen.</div>
  <label>Choose Photo or Video</label><input id="mediaFile" type="file" accept="image/*,video/*">
  <label>Media Caption</label><input id="mediaCaption" maxlength="80" placeholder="Optional caption">
  <button class="primary" style="margin-top:12px" onclick="addFeaturedMedia()">＋ Add Media</button>
  <div style="margin-top:18px">${state.featured.length?state.featured.map((m,i)=>`<div class="goal"><span class="goal-text">${esc(m.caption||"Untitled media")}</span><button class="danger" onclick="deleteFeatured(${i})">Delete</button></div>`).join(""):"<p class='small'>No media added yet.</p>"}</div>
 `)
}
async function addFeaturedMedia(){
 const f=$("mediaFile").files[0];if(!f)return toast("Choose a photo or video.");
 if(f.size>70*1024*1024)return toast("Please use a file smaller than 70 MB.");
 const key="featured_"+Date.now()+"_"+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);
 try{
  await idbPut(key,f);state.featured.push({key,type:f.type.startsWith("video")?"video":"image",caption:$("mediaCaption").value.trim(),name:f.name});
  save();renderFeatured();closeModal();toast("Media added.")
 }catch(e){toast("Could not save this media.")}
}
async function deleteFeatured(i){
 const m=state.featured[i];try{await idbDelete(m.key)}catch(e){}
 state.featured.splice(i,1);if(featuredIndex>=state.featured.length)featuredIndex=0;save();renderFeatured();openMediaManager()
}
async function renderFeatured(){
 const box=$("featuredMedia");if(!state.featured.length){
  box.innerHTML='<div class="media-box"><div class="media-empty">No photo or video yet.<br><br><button class="secondary" onclick="openMediaManager()">＋ Add Photo / Video</button></div></div>';return
 }
 const m=state.featured[featuredIndex]||state.featured[0];let file;
 try{file=await idbGet(m.key)}catch(e){}
 if(!file){box.innerHTML='<div class="media-box"><div class="media-empty">Media unavailable.</div></div>';return}
 const url=URL.createObjectURL(file);
 box.innerHTML=`<div class="media-box">${m.type==="video"?`<video src="${url}" controls playsinline></video>`:`<img src="${url}" alt="">`}
  <div class="media-tools"><button class="secondary" onclick="prevFeatured()">‹</button><button class="secondary" onclick="nextFeatured()">›</button><button class="danger" onclick="openMediaManager()">Manage</button></div></div>
  <div class="dots">${state.featured.map((_,i)=>`<i class="dot ${i===featuredIndex?"active":""}"></i>`).join("")}</div>
  <p class="small" style="margin:7px 3px 0">${esc(m.caption||"")}</p>`
}
function prevFeatured(){featuredIndex=(featuredIndex-1+state.featured.length)%state.featured.length;renderFeatured()}
function nextFeatured(){featuredIndex=(featuredIndex+1)%state.featured.length;renderFeatured()}

/* PROJECTS */
function projectDefault(){
 return {id:Date.now(),name:"",photo:null,bg:null,msg:"",goals:[],reminders:[],timer:{duration:0,endAt:null,remaining:0,running:false}}
}
function goalRow(g={},i=0){
 return `<div class="goal"><input type="checkbox" ${g.done?"checked":""}><span class="goal-text">${esc(g.text||"")}</span><input class="goalEdit" value="${esc(g.text||"")}" placeholder="Goal ${i+1}" style="display:none"><button class="danger" onclick="this.parentElement.remove()">×</button></div>`
}
function reminderRow(r={}){
 return `<div class="reminder"><div class="reminder-head"><b>Reminder</b><button class="danger" onclick="this.parentElement.parentElement.remove()">Remove</button></div>
 <label>Time</label><input class="remTime" type="time" value="${esc(r.time||"")}">
 <label>Notification Message</label><input class="remMsg" value="${esc(r.msg||"")}" placeholder="What should the notification say?"></div>`
}
function openProjectEditor(index=null){
 const p=index===null?projectDefault():state.projects[index];
 showModal(index===null?"Create Project":"Edit Project",`
  <div class="notice">Lord, ${index===null?"set up your new project.":"update your project."}</div>
  <label>Project Picture</label><input id="pPhoto" type="file" accept="image/*"><img id="pPrev" class="preview ${p.photo?"":"hidden"}" src="${p.photo||""}">
  <label>Project Name</label><input id="pName" maxlength="80" value="${esc(p.name)}" placeholder="Lord, your project name?">
  <label>Notification Message</label><textarea id="pMsg" placeholder="Lord, what should the notification say?">${esc(p.msg)}</textarea>
  <div class="card"><div class="section-title"><h3>🎯 Goals</h3><button class="secondary" onclick="addGoalField()">＋ Add Goal</button></div>
   <div id="goalFields">${p.goals.map((g,i)=>`<div class="goal"><input class="goalTextInput" value="${esc(g.text)}" placeholder="Goal ${i+1}"><button class="danger" onclick="this.parentElement.remove()">×</button></div>`).join("")}</div>
  </div>
  <div class="card"><div class="section-title"><h3>⏰ Reminders</h3><button class="secondary" onclick="addReminderField()">＋ Add Reminder</button></div>
   <div id="reminderFields">${p.reminders.map(reminderRow).join("")}</div>
  </div>
  <div class="card"><h3>⏱️ Project Timer</h3><p class="small">Set a timer such as 30 minutes or 8 hours. It keeps calculating from the saved end time when you leave the project.</p>
   <label>Hours</label><input id="tHours" type="number" min="0" step="1" value="${p.timer.duration?Math.floor(p.timer.duration/3600000):0}">
   <label>Minutes</label><input id="tMinutes" type="number" min="0" max="59" step="1" value="${p.timer.duration?Math.floor((p.timer.duration%3600000)/60000):30}">
  </div>
  <label>Project Background</label><input id="pBg" type="file" accept="image/*"><img id="pBgPrev" class="preview ${p.bg?"":"hidden"}" src="${p.bg||""}">
  <button class="primary" style="margin-top:14px" onclick="saveProject(${index===null?"null":index})">${index===null?"Create Project":"Save Project"}</button>
  ${index!==null?`<button class="danger" style="width:100%;margin-top:9px" onclick="deleteProject(${index})">Delete Project</button>`:""}
 `);
 $("pPhoto").onchange=e=>fileData(e.target.files[0],async s=>{if(s){$("pPrev").src=await compressImage(s,600,.8);$("pPrev").classList.remove("hidden")}})
 $("pBg").onchange=e=>fileData(e.target.files[0],async s=>{if(s){$("pBgPrev").src=await compressImage(s,1100,.78);$("pBgPrev").classList.remove("hidden")}})
}
function addGoalField(){const n=$("goalFields").children.length+1;$("goalFields").insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend",`<div class="goal"><input class="goalTextInput" placeholder="Goal ${n}"><button class="danger" onclick="this.parentElement.remove()">×</button></div>`)}
function addReminderField(){$("reminderFields").insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend",reminderRow({}))}
function saveProject(index){
 const n=$("pName").value.trim();if(!n)return toast("Please enter a project name.");
 const goals=[...document.querySelectorAll(".goalTextInput")].map(x=>x.value.trim()).filter(Boolean).map(x=>({text:x,done:false}));
 const reminders=[...document.querySelectorAll(".reminder")].map(x=>({time:x.querySelector(".remTime").value,msg:x.querySelector(".remMsg").value.trim()})).filter(x=>x.time);
 let hours=Math.max(0,Number($("tHours").value)||0),mins=Math.max(0,Math.min(59,Number($("tMinutes").value)||0));
 const duration=(hours*60+mins)*60000;
 const old=index===null?null:state.projects[index];
 const build=async(photo,bg)=>{
  const timer=old?.timer||{duration:0,endAt:null,remaining:0,running:false};
  if(duration>0 && !timer.running){timer.duration=duration;timer.remaining=duration}
  const p={id:old?.id||Date.now(),name:n,photo:photo||old?.photo||state.profile.photo,bg:bg||old?.bg||state.bg,msg:$("pMsg").value.trim(),goals,reminders,timer};
  if(index===null)state.projects.push(p);else state.projects[index]=p;
  save();renderProjects();closeModal();toast(index===null?"Project created.":"Project saved.")
 };
 const pf=$("pPhoto").files[0],bf=$("pBg").files[0];
 if(pf)fileData(pf,async s=>{const photo=await compressImage(s,650,.8);if(bf)fileData(bf,async b=>build(photo,await compressImage(b,1100,.78)));else build(photo,null)})
 else if(bf)fileData(bf,async b=>build(null,await compressImage(b,1100,.78)));else build(null,null)
}
function renderProjects(){
 const b=$("projectList");if(!state.projects.length){b.innerHTML='<div class="empty card" style="grid-column:1/-1">No projects yet.<br>Tap Create Project to start.</div>';return}
 b.innerHTML=state.projects.map((p,i)=>`<div class="card project-card" onclick="openProject(${i})">
  <div class="project-bg" style="background-image:url('${p.bg||state.bg}')"></div><div class="project-overlay"></div>
  <div class="project-content"><img class="project-photo" src="${p.photo||state.profile.photo}"><div class="bottom"><div class="project-name">${esc(p.name)}</div>
  <div class="project-meta">${p.goals.length} goals · ${p.reminders.length} reminders ${p.timer?.duration?"· Timer set":""}</div></div></div></div>`).join("")
}
function formatTime(ms){
 ms=Math.max(0,Math.floor(ms/1000));const h=Math.floor(ms/3600),m=Math.floor((ms%3600)/60),s=ms%60;
 return [h,m,s].map((v,i)=>i===0?String(v).padStart(2,"0"):String(v).padStart(2,"0")).join(":")
}
function openProject(i){
 activeProject=i;const p=state.projects[i];updateProjectTimerData(p);
 showProjectModal()
}
function updateProjectTimerData(p){
 if(!p.timer)p.timer={duration:0,endAt:null,remaining:0,running:false};
 if(p.timer.running&&p.timer.endAt){p.timer.remaining=Math.max(0,p.timer.endAt-Date.now());if(p.timer.remaining<=0){p.timer.running=false;p.timer.endAt=null;p.timer.remaining=0;save();timerFinished(activeProject)}}
}
function showProjectModal(){
 const p=state.projects[activeProject],t=p.timer||{duration:0,remaining:0,running:false};
 updateProjectTimerData(p);
 const remaining=t.running?Math.max(0,t.endAt-Date.now()):Math.max(0,t.remaining||t.duration||0);
 const pct=t.duration?Math.max(0,Math.min(100,remaining/t.duration*100)):0;
 showModal(esc(p.name),`
  <div class="card" style="padding:0;overflow:hidden;min-height:190px;background:linear-gradient(#0003,#000c),url('${p.bg||state.bg}') center/cover">
   <div style="padding:18px;min-height:190px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end"><img src="${p.photo||state.profile.photo}" class="project-photo"><h2 style="margin:10px 0 4px">${esc(p.name)}</h2><p style="margin:0">${esc(p.msg||"")}</p></div>
  </div>
  <div class="card"><div class="section-title"><h3>⏱️ Timer</h3><span class="timer-chip">${t.running?"RUNNING":"PAUSED"}</span></div>
   <div class="timer-box"><div id="projectTimerDisplay" class="timer-display">${formatTime(remaining)}</div>
   <div class="progress"><i id="projectProgress" style="width:${pct}%"></i></div>
   <div class="row">
    <button class="primary" onclick="startProjectTimer()">▶ Start</button>
    <button class="secondary" onclick="pauseProjectTimer()">Ⅱ Pause</button>
    <button class="secondary" onclick="restartProjectTimer()">↻ Restart</button>
    <button class="secondary" onclick="adjustProjectTime(10*60000)">＋10 min</button>
    <button class="secondary" onclick="adjustProjectTime(-10*60000)">−10 min</button>
   </div></div>
   <label>Timer notification message</label><textarea id="projectTimerMsg">${esc(p.msg||"Lord, your timer is finished.")}</textarea>
  </div>
  <div class="card"><div class="section-title"><h3>🎯 Goals</h3><button class="secondary" onclick="closeModal();openProjectEditor(${activeProject})">Edit</button></div>
   ${p.goals.length?p.goals.map((g,j)=>`<div class="goal ${g.done?"done":""}"><input type="checkbox" ${g.done?"checked":""} onchange="toggleGoal(${activeProject},${j},this.checked)"><span class="goal-text">${esc(g.text)}</span></div>`).join(""):"<p class='small'>No goals yet.</p>"}
  </div>
  <div class="card"><div class="section-title"><h3>🔔 Reminders</h3></div>
   ${p.reminders.length?p.reminders.map(r=>`<div class="reminder"><div class="reminder-head"><span class="reminder-time">${esc(r.time)}</span><span class="small">${esc(r.msg||p.msg||"Reminder")}</span></div></div>`).join(""):"<p class='small'>No reminders yet.</p>"}
  </div>
 `);
 clearInterval(projectTick);projectTick=setInterval(refreshOpenProjectTimer,250)
}
function refreshOpenProjectTimer(){
 if(activeProject===null||$("projectTimerDisplay")===null){clearInterval(projectTick);return}
 const p=state.projects[activeProject];updateProjectTimerData(p);const t=p.timer;
 const rem=t.running?Math.max(0,t.endAt-Date.now()):Math.max(0,t.remaining||0);
 $("projectTimerDisplay").textContent=formatTime(rem);
 const pct=t.duration?Math.max(0,Math.min(100,rem/t.duration*100)):0;
 if($("projectProgress"))$("projectProgress").style.width=pct+"%"
}
function startProjectTimer(){
 const p=state.projects[activeProject];if(!p)return;
 const t=p.timer;if(!t.remaining)t.remaining=t.duration;
 if(!t.remaining)return toast("Set a timer duration first by editing the project.");
 t.running=true;t.endAt=Date.now()+t.remaining;save();refreshOpenProjectTimer();toast("Project timer started.")
}
function pauseProjectTimer(){
 const p=state.projects[activeProject];if(!p?.timer)return;
 if(p.timer.running){p.timer.remaining=Math.max(0,p.timer.endAt-Date.now());p.timer.running=false;p.timer.endAt=null;save();refreshOpenProjectTimer();toast("Timer paused.")}
}
function restartProjectTimer(){
 const p=state.projects[activeProject];if(!p?.timer?.duration)return toast("Set a timer duration first.");
 p.timer.remaining=p.timer.duration;p.timer.running=true;p.timer.endAt=Date.now()+p.timer.duration;save();refreshOpenProjectTimer();toast("Timer restarted.")
}
function adjustProjectTime(delta){
 const p=state.projects[activeProject];if(!p)return;const t=p.timer;
 let rem=t.running?Math.max(0,t.endAt-Date.now()):Math.max(0,t.remaining||0);rem=Math.max(0,rem+delta);t.remaining=rem;t.duration=Math.max(t.duration||0,t.duration?Math.max(t.duration,rem):rem);
 if(t.running)t.endAt=Date.now()+rem;save();refreshOpenProjectTimer();toast((delta>0?"+":"−")+"10 minutes")
}
function timerFinished(i){
 const p=state.projects[i];if(!p)return;const msg=p._timerMsg||p.msg||"Lord, your timer is finished.";
 sendNotice(p.name,msg);setTimeout(()=>{if(activeProject===i)showTimerFinishedPopup(i,msg)},50)
}
function showTimerFinishedPopup(i,msg){
 showModal("⏰ Timer Finished",`<div class="notice"><b>${esc(msg)}</b></div>
 <p class="small">You can add or remove time in 10-minute steps.</p>
 <div class="row"><button class="primary" onclick="closeModal();adjustProjectTime(10*60000);startProjectTimer()">＋10 min & Start</button><button class="secondary" onclick="closeModal()">OK</button></div>
 <button class="danger" style="width:100%;margin-top:9px" onclick="closeModal();adjustProjectTime(-10*60000)">−10 min</button>`)
}
function toggleGoal(pi,gi,v){state.projects[pi].goals[gi].done=v;save()}

/* WORKOUT */
function openWorkoutManager(){
 showModal("🏋️ Work Out",`
  <div class="notice">Create plans in order. When a workout starts, each plan's video and countdown run automatically one after another.</div>
  <div class="card"><div class="section-title"><h3>Plans</h3><button class="secondary" onclick="addWorkoutPlan()">＋ Add Plan</button></div>
   <div id="workoutPlanList"></div>
  </div>
  ${state.workout.plans.length?`<button class="primary" onclick="startWorkout()">▶ Start Workout</button>`:""}
 `);renderWorkoutPlans()
}
function renderWorkoutPlans(){
 const box=$("workoutPlanList");if(!box)return;
 if(!state.workout.plans.length){box.innerHTML='<p class="small">No plans yet. Add your first plan.</p>';return}
 box.innerHTML=state.workout.plans.map((p,i)=>`<div class="workout-plan">
  <div class="workout-thumb" id="wthumb${i}"></div><div class="info"><b>Plan ${i+1}: ${esc(p.name)}</b><span>${formatTime(p.duration)} · ${p.fileName?esc(p.fileName):"No video"}</span></div>
  <button class="secondary" onclick="editWorkoutPlan(${i})">Edit</button><button class="danger" onclick="deleteWorkoutPlan(${i})">×</button>
 </div>`).join("");
 state.workout.plans.forEach(async(p,i)=>{
  if(p.key){const f=await idbGet(p.key);if(f&&$("wthumb"+i)){$("wthumb"+i).style.backgroundImage="url('"+URL.createObjectURL(f)+"')";$("wthumb"+i).style.backgroundSize="cover";$("wthumb"+i).style.backgroundPosition="center"}}
 })
}
function addWorkoutPlan(){editWorkoutPlan(null)}
function editWorkoutPlan(i){
 const p=i===null?{name:"",duration:30000,key:null,fileName:""}:state.workout.plans[i];
 showModal(i===null?"Add Workout Plan":"Edit Workout Plan",`
  <label>Plan Name</label><input id="wName" maxlength="60" value="${esc(p.name)}" placeholder="Example: Push Ups">
  <label>Video</label><input id="wVideo" type="file" accept="video/*">
  <p class="small">${p.fileName?"Current: "+esc(p.fileName):"Choose a video for this plan."}</p>
  <label>Time (minutes)</label><input id="wMin" type="number" min="0" step="1" value="${Math.floor(p.duration/60000)}">
  <label>Extra seconds</label><input id="wSec" type="number" min="0" max="59" value="${Math.floor((p.duration%60000)/1000)}">
  <button class="primary" style="margin-top:14px" onclick="saveWorkoutPlan(${i===null?"null":i})">${i===null?"Add Plan":"Save Plan"}</button>
 `)
}
async function saveWorkoutPlan(i){
 const name=$("wName").value.trim(),f=$("wVideo").files[0],min=Math.max(0,Number($("wMin").value)||0),sec=Math.max(0,Math.min(59,Number($("wSec").value)||0));
 if(!name)return toast("Enter a plan name.");if(!f&&i===null)return toast("Choose a video.");
 const old=i===null?null:state.workout.plans[i];let key=old?.key||null,fileName=old?.fileName||"";
 try{if(f){key="workout_"+(old?.id||Date.now())+"_"+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);await idbPut(key,f);fileName=f.name}}
 catch(e){return toast("Could not save the video.")}
 const p={id:old?.id||Date.now(),name,duration:(min*60+sec)*1000,key,fileName,createdAt:old?.createdAt||Date.now()};
 if(!p.duration)return toast("Set a workout time.");
 if(i===null){state.workout.plans.push(p);ensureWorkoutHistory()}else state.workout.plans[i]=p;save();openWorkoutManager();refreshWorkoutHistory();toast(i===null?"Plan added.":"Plan updated.")
}
async function deleteWorkoutPlan(i){
 const p=state.workout.plans[i];if(p.key)try{await idbDelete(p.key)}catch(e){}
 delete state.workout.history[p.id];state.workout.plans.splice(i,1);save();openWorkoutManager();refreshWorkoutHistory()
}
async function startWorkout(){
 if(!state.workout.plans.length)return toast("Add a plan first.");
 if(state.workout.plans.some(p=>!p.key||!p.duration))return toast("Every plan needs a video and time.");
 workout={index:0,startedAt:Date.now(),planStartedAt:Date.now(),remaining:state.workout.plans[0].duration,finished:0,paused:false};
 closeModal();showWorkoutStage();runWorkoutPlan()
}
async function runWorkoutPlan(){
 if(!workout)return;const p=state.workout.plans[workout.index];workout.planStartedAt=Date.now();workout.remaining=p.duration;
 showWorkoutStage();const f=await idbGet(p.key);if(f&&$("workoutVideo")){$("workoutVideo").src=URL.createObjectURL(f);$("workoutVideo").play().catch(()=>{})}
 clearInterval(workoutTick);workoutTick=setInterval(workoutUpdate,100)
}
function showWorkoutStage(){
 const p=state.workout.plans[workout.index],elapsed=Date.now()-workout.planStartedAt;
 showModal("🏋️ Work Out",`
  <div class="workout-stage"><video id="workoutVideo" controls playsinline></video>
   <div class="workout-count"><div class="small">Plan ${workout.index+1} of ${state.workout.plans.length}</div><div id="workoutCountdown" class="big">${formatTime(Math.max(0,p.duration-elapsed))}</div></div>
  </div>
  <div class="stats" style="margin-top:12px"><div class="stat"><b id="workDone">${workout.finished}</b><span>Plans Done</span></div><div class="stat"><b>${state.workout.plans.length}</b><span>Total Plans</span></div><div class="stat"><b id="workTotal">${formatTime(Date.now()-workout.startedAt)}</b><span>Total Time</span></div></div>
  <div class="row" style="margin-top:12px"><button class="secondary" onclick="pauseWorkout()">Ⅱ Pause</button><button class="secondary" onclick="resumeWorkout()">▶ Resume</button><button class="danger" onclick="stopWorkout()">Stop Workout</button></div>
 `)
}
function workoutUpdate(){
 if(!workout||workout.paused)return;
 const p=state.workout.plans[workout.index],rem=Math.max(0,p.duration-(Date.now()-workout.planStartedAt));
 if($("workoutCountdown"))$("workoutCountdown").textContent=formatTime(rem);
 if($("workTotal"))$("workTotal").textContent=formatTime(Date.now()-workout.startedAt);
 if(rem<=0){clearInterval(workoutTick);markWorkoutDone(p.id,todayKey());workout.finished++;workout.index++;if(workout.index>=state.workout.plans.length){finishWorkout();return}runWorkoutPlan()}
}
function pauseWorkout(){if(workout){workout.paused=true;const v=$("workoutVideo");if(v)v.pause();toast("Workout paused.")}}
function resumeWorkout(){if(workout){workout.paused=false;const v=$("workoutVideo");if(v)v.play().catch(()=>{});toast("Workout resumed.")}}
function stopWorkout(){clearInterval(workoutTick);workout=null;closeModal();toast("Workout stopped.")}
function finishWorkout(){
 clearInterval(workoutTick);const total=Date.now()-workout.startedAt,count=workout.finished;workout=null;
 showModal("🏆 Congratulations Lord",`<div class="card" style="text-align:center"><div style="font-size:58px">🎉</div><h2>Congratulations Lord</h2><p>You completed <b>${count}</b> plan${count===1?"":"s"}.</p><p>Total Time</p><strong style="font-size:30px">${formatTime(total)}</strong></div>
 <button class="primary" onclick="closeModal();openWorkoutManager()">🔄 Start Again</button>`)
 sendNotice("Congratulations Lord","Your workout is complete.")
}

/* WORKOUT DAILY HISTORY & SCORE */
function todayKey(d=new Date()){
 const y=d.getFullYear(),m=String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,"0"),day=String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,"0");
 return `${y}-${m}-${day}`
}
function localDateFromKey(k){const [y,m,d]=k.split("-").map(Number);return new Date(y,m-1,d)}
function dateLabel(k){return localDateFromKey(k).toLocaleDateString(undefined,{day:"2-digit",month:"short",year:"numeric"})}
function ensureWorkoutHistory(){
 if(!state.workout)state.workout={plans:[],history:{}};
 if(!state.workout.history)state.workout.history={};
 state.workout.plans.forEach(p=>{if(!state.workout.history[p.id])state.workout.history[p.id]={score:0,days:{}}});
}
function processWorkoutDays(){
 ensureWorkoutHistory();
 const today=localDateFromKey(todayKey());
 state.workout.plans.forEach(p=>{
   const h=state.workout.history[p.id];
   const created=localDateFromKey(todayKey(new Date(p.createdAt||Date.now())));
   const cursor=new Date(created);
   while(cursor<today){
     const k=todayKey(cursor);
     if(h.days[k]===undefined){h.days[k]=false;h.score=(Number(h.score)||0)-1}
     cursor.setDate(cursor.getDate()+1);
   }
 });
 save();
}
function markWorkoutDone(planId,k=todayKey()){
 ensureWorkoutHistory();
 const h=state.workout.history[planId];
 if(h.days[k]===true)return;
 if(h.days[k]===false)h.score=(Number(h.score)||0)+2; else h.score=(Number(h.score)||0)+1;
 h.days[k]=true;save();refreshWorkoutHistory();
}
function renderWorkoutDates(p){
 const h=state.workout.history[p.id]||{score:0,days:{}};
 const created=localDateFromKey(todayKey(new Date(p.createdAt||Date.now()))),today=localDateFromKey(todayKey());
 const arr=[];let d=new Date(created);let guard=0;
 while(d<=today&&guard<3660){
   const k=todayKey(d),v=h.days[k];
   arr.push(`<div class="wh-date ${v===true?"done":v===false?"missed":"pending"}"><b>${v===true?"✓":v===false?"✕":"•"}</b><small>${dateLabel(k)}</small></div>`);
   d.setDate(d.getDate()+1);guard++;
 }
 return arr.join("");
}
function refreshWorkoutHistory(){
 ensureWorkoutHistory();
 const box=$("workoutHistoryList");if(!box)return;
 if(!state.workout.plans.length){box.innerHTML='<p class="small">No workout plans yet. Add your first plan above.</p>';return}
 const tk=todayKey();
 box.innerHTML=state.workout.plans.map((p,i)=>{
   const h=state.workout.history[p.id]||{score:0,days:{}};
   const done=h.days[tk]===true;
   const action=done?'<p class="small" style="margin:10px 0 0">Today completed ✓</p>':`<button class="secondary wh-mark" onclick="markWorkoutDone(${p.id})">✓ Mark Today's Workout Done</button>`;
   return `<div class="wh-plan"><div class="wh-head"><div class="wh-name"><b>🏋️ ${esc(p.name)}</b><div class="small">Plan ${i+1} · Score: <strong>${Number(h.score)||0}</strong></div></div><div class="wh-score">${done?"✓":"•"}</div></div><div class="wh-dates">${renderWorkoutDates(p)}</div>${action}</div>`
 }).join("");
}
function showTodayWorkoutPopup(){
 ensureWorkoutHistory();
 const pending=state.workout.plans.filter(p=>(state.workout.history[p.id]?.days?.[todayKey()]!==true));
 if(!pending.length)return;
 const names=pending.map(p=>`<li>${esc(p.name)}</li>`).join("");
 setTimeout(()=>showModal("🏋️ Today's Workouts",`<div class="notice"><b>Lord, তোমার আজকের এই Workoutগুলো বাকি আছে:</b><ul style="text-align:left;line-height:1.8">${names}</ul></div><button class="primary" onclick="closeModal()">OK</button>`),350);
}

/* REMINDER ENGINE */
function checkReminders(){
 const now=new Date(),hh=String(now.getHours()).padStart(2,"0"),mm=String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2,"0"),key=now.toDateString()+" "+hh+":"+mm;
 if(state.lastCheckKey===key)return;state.lastCheckKey=key;save();
 state.projects.forEach(p=>p.reminders.forEach(r=>{if(r.time===hh+":"+mm){
   sendNotice(p.name,r.msg||p.msg||"Lord, your reminder is ready.")
 }}));
 state.projects.forEach((p,i)=>{
  if(p.timer?.running&&p.timer.endAt<=Date.now()){p.timer.running=false;p.timer.remaining=0;p.timer.endAt=null;save();p._timerMsg=p.msg||"Lord, your timer is finished.";timerFinished(i)}
 })
}
setInterval(checkReminders,1000);

function init(){setBG();if(state.profile)startApp();else $("setup").classList.remove("hidden")}
init();
</script>
</body>
</html>
